name: StateSwitch
author: masaribconnect

sections.description:
StateSwitch requires WooCommerce. It provides State A/B image switching, native-gallery-compatible product and archive presentation, transitions, and placement/alignment controls. It has no telemetry, analytics, external fonts, or remote API dependency.

StateSwitch Pro adds optional advanced presentation, Preview Studio, Atmosphere, catalogue tools, CSV workflows, First-Time Switch Helper, and Elementor integration. Those features are not included in StateSwitch Free.

Privacy

StateSwitch processes settings and product metadata only inside WordPress. It does not send data to external services.

When “Remember Visitor State” is enabled, StateSwitch stores the selected state (a or b) in the visitor’s browser local storage. This contains no personal data and is not transmitted to StateSwitch or any external service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate StateSwitch.
  2. Ensure WooCommerce is active.
  3. Configure WooCommerce > StateSwitch and add an alternate image to compatible products.
sections.faq:
Does it delete data on deactivation?

No. A separate opt-in setting controls removal only during uninstall.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Improved WooCommerce native gallery compatibility and State A/B storefront switching.
  • Improved placement, alignment, and extension compatibility for StateSwitch Pro.

1.0.0

Initial public release.
